output.summary: A woody shrub native to South America, including Brazil, Paraguay and parts of the Andes. Its starchy storage roots are an important food crop, but roots, peels and leaves require correct preparation because raw or poorly processed material can release poisonous cyanide.
output.edibilityNote: Starchy roots are eaten boiled or processed into flour and tapioca; roots, peels and leaves are dangerous raw and require correct preparation.
